title: Separating scalarization specification, Pareto geometry and anchor provenance in surrogate-assisted multiobjective XGBoost hyperparameter optimization — protocol, code and analysis artifacts

creators.name: Tertuliano Ribeiro, Caio
creators.affiliation: Institute of Production Engineering and Management (IEPG), Federal University of Itajubá (UNIFEI), Itajubá, MG, Brazil

creators.name: Costa Pereira, Matheus

creators.name: de Paiva, Anderson Paulo

description:
Frozen protocol, campaign implementation, analysis code and aggregated result artifacts for a replicated study that separates three choices surrogate-assisted multiobjective hyperparameter optimization pipelines normally change together: the scalarization specification, the geometry by which a Pareto front is constructed, and the provenance of the anchors and payoff matrix that geometry uses.

What this deposit contains: the protocol as frozen before the confirmatory campaign, the campaign and analysis source code, the 88-run face-centred central composite design, the frozen per-dataset factor models, aggregated per-unit indicator tables, the analysis artifacts every reported number is read from, environment and dependency information, and reproducibility instructions.

What it deliberately does not contain: raw datasets and the per-unit evaluation caches. The four datasets are public and are retrieved by checksum-verified loaders; redistributing them here would add nothing and is avoided. The evaluation caches are large intermediate state, not evidence.
